title: Chapter 647
paragraphs: Chapter 647
Episode 165. After the Shock (1)
The Red Owl couldn't move in one go to the set return coordinates, Tikan.
Originally, neither the Red Owl nor Mort were affected by chaos particles, but Rosa's spiritual energy, which covered Kalon, was so dense that it exceeded that standard.
They crash-landed several times in unnamed forests, seas, and islands.
Spiritual energy was attached to the hull of the Red Owl like rust, and every time they tried a new space leap, an anxious noise rang from the power source.

'According to the manual, as long as the nucleus of the power and the hull's passenger compartment are not completely destroyed, there's a high possibility of eventually reaching the set coordinates...'
The problem was Talaris.
Her whole body, unconscious, was emanating heat like a fireball.
Her pulse was unstable, and the backlash reaction was so severe that aura was being emitted randomly.
She needed treatment as soon as possible.
If he had his way, he would have liked to take her to Shuri first to the healers.
However, even Shuri would have to wander for a while to find the way from their current location.
They had no choice but to continue to try space leaps, hoping to land near the kingdom or to arrive in Tikan.
So five space leaps followed. All were failures. The Red Owl kept falling on some random land.
However, it was certain that they were moving away from Huphester.
Also, with every space leap, the spiritual energy stuck to the hull fell off, and the sound of the power source was becoming more stable.
If this continues, he had a feeling that they would be able to reach Tikan soon.
Just as Jin was about to press the button in the center of the cockpit once more, he could suddenly hear a familiar voice out of nowhere.
(Huh, Jin!?)
It was Lingling's voice. It felt very distant, but it was definitely Lingling.
"...Lingling!?"
Jin looked around as if he was possessed by a ghost. Naturally, he couldn't see Lingling.
Moreover, it wasn't just Lingling's voice he could hear.
(Who are you to suddenly come into my head and cause a commotion!? No, can you hear my voice?)
“I can hear you. Can you hear me?”
(Uh, I feel bad!)
(What, Jin, my brother!?)
(Jin, my brother!? Didn't Kaio just get summoned?)
(Where is Jin!? Lingling, are you really talking to Jin now?)

(How should I explain this? Suddenly, that idiot's figure popped up in my head and I heard his voice. He was muttering while pressing some kind of button. Beside him was a man with white hair, lying down.)
(Button? Muttering? A fallen person? Is Brother Jin in danger!?)
“Brothers! Can't you hear my voice?”
(Can't you hear that voice?)
(What do you mean you keep hearing something? Lingling, are you joking?)
(Ah, I'm frustrated! It's real! Jin is listening to your voices.)
For a few seconds, confused words flew between Jin, Lingling, and the Demon King tribe.
Jin could hear everyone's voice, but it seemed that Lafrarosa's side could not.
(Brothers, Lingling is not joking. She really hears Brother Jin's voice.)
(Oh. What's going on, Brother Tushin!)
Vahn, who was halfway connected with Lingling internally, quickly understood the situation.

(It seems that for some reason, a synchronization point has formed between Brother Jin and Lingling. Lingling, you relay Jin's words to us. Jin, how's it outside? You summoned Brother Shituwang, was there something hard to handle?)
Jin explained the events in the Sword Garden as concisely as possible.
(Insa is turning into a hell. If we could go out and help Brother right now, that would be great.)
“You've already helped enough, Brother Tushin.”
(Still, seeing Lafrarosa and Insa suddenly connected like this, I feel that the day we can go outside is not too far away.)
Synchronous waveform tracking spatial leap.
Jin guessed that this sudden 'connection' had something to do with him.
“Perhaps it's because of the aircraft my colleague made. It seems the aircraft has accidentally caught the wavelength of Lafrarosa.”
His guess was correct. The Red Owl catching Lafrarosa's wavelength was a kind of error.
(First, I heard that your colleague's condition is precarious. If she's white-haired, it would be a character named Talaris Endorma, who has helped Brother a lot.)
"That's right. Her condition is critical."
(Close your eyes and concentrate. Maybe I can help her through Lingling and Brother.)
Vahn's words were unmistakable.
He was trying to merge with Tushin. Jin immediately closed his eyes and concentrated on the synchronization point with Lingling.
Then, as it did from Lafrarosa, he felt Vahn's sense and energy slowly being conveyed as the nuclear heart glowed.
'Even though it's a weaker level than when I did it in Lafrarosa... definitely, the merger with Tushin is happening...!'
Perhaps because of the dimensional distance between Insa and Lafrarosa, Vahn's senses were not fully conveyed.
However, that alone was enough to examine Talaris' condition.
(The meridians and blood vessels are all damaged. The power with the attribute of cold is preventing the worst situation. But at this rate, it will reach the limit within one or two hours.)
"So if that happens......")
"Even if she doesn't die, she may never be able to perform as before."
Before he entered the Unity of the Gods, he could only guess that it was just a status quo, but now he could accurately perceive what Jin and Vahn were feeling.
"Follow my senses and put energy into her body. Erase the coldness that seems to be cut off at any moment and replace it with energy."
Jin put his hand on Talaris' back, following Vahn's words.
His energy slowly dug into her injuries, passing through the tangled blood vessels.
Despite it being only for a moment, he was drenched in sweat. Talaris vomited a black clot of blood even though she was unconscious, and Jin felt as if he was walking on a thin line called her life.
However, Jin trusted Vahn. Unlike his own anxiety, there was not an inch of worry from Vahn's interior.
"Huff..."
Finally, the heat of the severe injuries that seemed to melt her whole body disappeared, and Talaris exhaled hotly.
Although she had not regained consciousness, Talaris now appeared to be in a comfortable sleep.
"It's done. However, Jin, this is a stopgap measure. We have to start proper treatment within at least three days."
"Understood, Gods!"
He wanted to spend more time with his brothers, but that was not the situation.
He had to try space leaping again. It was lucky to get past Talaris's critical moment, but it was never safe until he returned to Tikan.
Even after returning, there were problems.
The power that Rosas' Runcandle, which he experienced directly this time, possessed was overwhelming all other great powers.
He had to inform his colleagues of this fact and prepare for future situations.
Perhaps it was necessary to decide on the whole migration of Tikan.
If the current Runcandle immediately begins to track with full force and hits Tikan, Jin and his colleagues had no power to stop it.
This was not only for Tikan but for all other powers. No matter how great the hidden power they had, it didn't seem to exceed Rosas' Runcandle.
Despite leading a fleet close to full power, it was defeated.
Jin didn't watch the battle to the end, but he couldn't think that Rosa had been defeated.
"Brothers, Lingling. I'll go now. As soon as I return, I will find out about this coincidence. As the God Brothers said, this coincidence seems to be a big clue for the brothers to come out."
The Unity of the Gods was waning. It was Vahn who was withdrawing his power before Jin released it.
"Go quickly, Brother Jin. I'll wait for the day we can contact again."
"Heh, go quickly! And don't blow up anywhere else."
After saying goodbye to his brothers, Jin pressed the button of the Red Owl again.
February 27, 1803.
Jin was able to reach Tikan only after two days had passed.
There had been more than ten space leaps after calming Talaris's internal injuries, none of which reconnected to Lafrarosa.
Upon arrival, Talaris was immediately transported to the holy nation, and Jin was informed about the information other comrades had gathered in the meantime.
Fortunately.
Since that day, Runcandel had not yet deployed forces externally.
"We're not sure whether they're not deploying forces or they're unable to," said one comrade.
"I think it's the latter. Runcandel would need time to recover their forces, and most of all, they must have faced a tremendous cost for using such a powerful force."

"I agree, sir. But already, including the Garden of Swords and the city of Calon, it is reported that over 50% of the Huphester Alliance has been swallowed by chaos. This happened within the two days since you escaped, sir. Just in two days."
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that the entire continent of Huphester was being swallowed by chaos. Such an erosion occurred just within two days.
It was impossible to confirm the internal situation. Even the lands that hadn't been eroded yet were not open for entry.
"Perhaps the Garden of Swords plans to swallow the entire world in this way. If the whole world is swallowed by chaos, there would be no need to track us or other forces...."
Zipple and Kinzelo.
After Jin's escape, they continued a total offensive before deciding to retreat. All suffered severe damage.
"According to a report received at noon today, the fleet of Zipple that appeared over the sea of Lutero Magic Federation was only three."
"That means they've lost half of their six fleets. Have there been any updates on Kinzelo?"
"No, sir. However, since we have not detected any signs of retreat on the estimated routes, we presume they retreated using Orgal's ability. If so, their situation is likely better than Zipple's."
Unlike Jin, his comrades understood the situation based on the reports of the Rainbow Birds after the battle.
Each report was shocking. No one had expected that Runcandel would prevail against all other forces, including Jin.
Moreover, Rosa Runcandel was no longer a temporary ruler.
As soon as all her enemies retreated, she declared to the world that she had become the 'ruler' of Runcandel.
First, he needed to meet the leaders of Zipple and Kinzelo.
"We will be contacted by both forces soon. They must be thinking the same as I do. Let me know immediately."
"Yes, sir."
"And the knights who escaped... there's still no news?"
The knights who resisted Rosa until the end.
Just as he was worried about the uncertain fate of these knights, Zhet rushed into the meeting room.
"Sir! The survival of the knights you saved has been confirmed...! Right now, Kikantel is personally going to pick them up!"
Jin closed his eyes, his hand over his heart.
If they all had died, there would really be few people left in the world that could be called Runcandel.
